evidence.locator: InterHuman Dataset; Data Structure; motion generation tasks
evidence.statement: The release contains raw SMPL motion and processed per-joint positions/rotations for interacting people, with text annotations and train/validation/test splits. Its generation tasks operate on ordered skeletal trajectories.

yearBasis.description: Original InterGen/InterHuman preprint in April 2023; later IJCV 2024 publication.
